next_tickets.body: Freeze the S27a winning correction and repeat the quantization-stratified timing benchmark on an independent run block or acquisition period, retaining the same traditional baseline and paired bootstrap CI procedure. Expected information gain: distinguishes a stable ADC quantization correction from a run-local waveform support artifact.
next_tickets.title: S27d: external run-block replication of ADC quantization timing correction

scientific_summary: The held-out winner is ridge with pairwise sigma68 1.4090 ns (95% CI 1.3301-1.4759) versus the training-selected traditional baseline traditional_template_phase at 3.0150 ns (95% CI 2.8940-3.0314). ADC quantization residual features are mapped as a systematic across pulse-shape, timing, pile-up, saturation, pedestal, energy, and PID-proxy strata; the result should be read as run-held-out timing-bias evidence, not external time truth.
title: ADC quantization pulse-shape timing bias map
